name: DataVisor

vendor.repo: No product repo. github.com/datavisor exists but holds only one unrelated toy R project (merkle, 1 star, Makefile). The fraud/AML platform is entirely closed-source.
vendor.scale: Founded 2013 by Yinglian Xie (CEO) and Fang Yu. Series F (~$35.85M, May 2023); investors incl. Brighton Park Capital, NEA, Sequoia, GSR, CMFG Ventures. Vendor claims 30B+ events/yr, 15,000+ QPS in production. Customers cited: NASA FCU, Affirm, TaskRabbit, Galileo.

dorks: http.html:"powered by DataVisor" OR http.html:"VERA" DataVisor

verification_primitive.probe: There is NO published unauthenticated read primitive for DataVisor. The only public, unauthenticated read is the marketing site (GET https://www.datavisor.com/). For any candidate product instance the responsible read-only probe is: GET / and GET /favicon.ico over TLS, then inspect HTTP title/body for the coined tokens 'dCube' / 'VERA' / 'powered by DataVisor' and record the TLS cert subject - WITHOUT submitting credentials or event data.
verification_primitive.success_signal: A login/console page whose title or body contains a confirmed DataVisor product token (dCube / VERA / DataVisor case management). NOTE: as of this dossier no such live, exposed, unauthenticated product surface has been confirmed to exist, so 'success' here means 'identified an operator/console,' not 'obtained data.'
verification_primitive.impact_when_open: If a misconfigured analyst console or decision API were found reachable without auth, impact would be severe (financial-crime case data, customer PII, model config) - but this is hypothetical; no open instance has been verified. Surface-open is unconfirmed; access not exercised.

endpoints.returns: Public marketing site (WordPress). Not the product.

endpoints.path: Real-time decision/ingestion REST API (per-tenant hostname, TLS 1.2)
endpoints.returns: UNKNOWN public path. Per docs it ingests event data and returns a risk score/decision JSON. Credentialed; no anonymous read documented.
UNKNOWN public path/hostname. Analyst web console; login-gated per vendor description.
